slides.title: Nine audiences, one move from display to CTV
slides.subtitle: The short version you asked for. The App Science® audiences for VYVGART® and EPSOLAY®, and the CTV inventory they run on.
slides.meta: Awareness strategy and $1MM CTV test | Prepared for minds + assembly | October 2026 | US only
slides.names:
Michael Allen
Ben Bring · Helen Goldstein

stat.label: Streaming's share of Rx TV
stat.body: Up from 32% in Q1. Rx TV budgets are moving to streaming this year, and the audiences can move with them. [2]

slides.title: Why start CTV with app audiences
slides.kicker: For clients buying mostly display today
slides.statLabel: VYVGART net sales growth in Q2 2026, to $1.52B. The label now covers every adult gMG serotype.
slides.headline: We think the safest first step into CTV is the audience you can already see on the phone, now on the TV.

points.head: Same audience, bigger screen
points.body: Each segment starts from apps opened on a phone in the last 30 days. We resolve the phone to the household and serve that home's TV.

points.head: Built per brand, never shared
points.body: Three audiences each for gMG, CIDP and EPSOLAY. argenx and Galderma data, reporting and learnings stay separate.

points.head: Proved with a holdout
points.body: 10% of homes stay unexposed, so brand lift and Rx lift read cleanly for each brand.

slides.title: VYVGART in gMG: three audiences
slides.kicker: Each one is an app ecosystem built for this brief · ~90K diagnosed US gMG patients
slides.source: Estimates; reconfirm before launch. From ~90K diagnosed US gMG patients (DelveInsight, 2025) on Sabio's 80MM-household graph, plus adjacent apps. App names are examples, not endorsements.

cards.name: The symptom tracker
cards.desc: Logs symptoms and sees a neurologist, often still on steroids.
cards.goal: Ask about VYVGART at the next visit

cards.name: The care partner
cards.desc: A spouse or adult child managing visits and medications.

cards.name: The serotype newcomer
cards.desc: MuSK+, LRP4+ or seronegative, newly covered in 2026.
cards.apps: MG patient groups · rare disease communities · MyChart
cards.goal: A VYVGART option for every serotype

slides.title: VYVGART in CIDP: three audiences
slides.kicker: Each one is an app ecosystem built for this brief · ~60K US CIDP patients
slides.source: Estimates; reconfirm before launch. From ~60K US CIDP patients (GBS|CIDP Foundation) on Sabio's 80MM-household graph, plus adjacent apps. App names are examples, not endorsements.

cards.name: The IVIg-fatigued patient
cards.desc: On a three to four week IVIg cycle, at home or in clinic.
cards.goal: A self-injection in place of the infusion chair

cards.name: The newly diagnosed
cards.desc: Researching numbness and weakness, often in their late 50s.

cards.name: The care partner
cards.desc: Drives to infusion visits and runs the calendar.
cards.goal: Treatment that fits around family life

slides.title: EPSOLAY in rosacea: three audiences
slides.kicker: The same method at scale · Only about 18% of 16MM Americans with rosacea are treated
slides.source: Estimates; reconfirm before launch. From 16MM Americans with rosacea, ~18% treated (National Rosacea Society), on Sabio's 80MM-household graph. App names are examples, not endorsements.

cards.name: The self-treater
cards.desc: Treats bumps and redness with OTC skin care. No dermatologist yet.

cards.name: The trigger manager
cards.desc: Tracks sun, heat and diet triggers. Often women aged 45 to 60.
cards.apps: UV index apps · Bearable · MyFitnessPal · Skinsort

cards.name: The topical switcher
cards.desc: On a prescription rosacea topical and still breaking out.
cards.apps: Curology · Musely · GoodRx · CVS / Walgreens Rx
cards.goal: Up to 70% fewer bumps in 12 weeks

slides.title: Nine audiences build to about 12.5MM homes
slides.kicker: Unique CTV households as each audience is added · Deduplicated · Illustrative until the build
slides.source: Bars show incremental, deduplicated households. Final sizes are confirmed at the build [CONFIRM].
slides.totalLabel: Unique CTV households across nine audiences
slides.body:
The $1MM test reaches about 9MM of them at an average frequency of about 6.

VYVGART adds about 2MM precise homes. EPSOLAY adds the scale.

slides.title: The CTV inventory we'd serve on
slides.kicker: Platform-agnostic CTV, plus our own channel · Your lists, our controls
slides.source: Creator TV distribution from Sabio's Q4 2026 overview. The full publisher list is shared at the build and cleared with each brand's MLR team [CONFIRM].

channels.head: Premium streaming
channels.body: Every major CTV platform, box and stick. We add your approved publishers and block the ones you already buy, so reach stays incremental.

channels.head: Creator TV®
channels.body: Sabio's own channel: 88MM households can watch it on VIZIO WatchFree+, TCLtv+, Xumo Play, Sling Freestream, Fire TV Channels, Plex and LiveTVx.

channels.head: Health-safe supply
channels.body: Category blocklists for each brand. DoubleVerify on every impression and a 70% viewability guarantee.

channels.head: Mobile follow-through
channels.body: The same CTV-exposed homes on their phones, pointing to vyvgart.com or epsolay.com and the doctor discussion guide.

gets: Frequency capped per household and brand
Separate delivery reports for argenx and Galderma

slides.title: The $1MM test and the guardrails
slides.source: Rx lift partner to be confirmed with argenx and Galderma; claims data stays de-identified. Sabio CTV privacy FAQ, 2026.

cells.head: Budget by brand
cells.body: VYVGART $350K gMG and $250K CIDP. EPSOLAY $400K. Budgets never move between brands without client approval.

cells.head: Measurement
cells.body: Brand lift for awareness and new-to-brand Rx lift, each read by brand against a 10% unexposed holdout.

cells.head: What we observe
cells.body: Which apps are on a device and when they were used. Never what a person types, logs or reads inside an app.

cells.head: Health data
cells.body: App ownership is a behavior signal. We don't infer a diagnosis, and copy never implies we know one.

cells.head: What leaves Sabio
cells.body: No raw device IDs. Reporting is aggregated by audience and kept separate for each client.

slides.title: Where we go next
slides.kicker: Three steps to a live test
slides.closer: Happy to keep trimming. If one brand is the better first conversation with your clients, we'll lead with that one.

moves.head: Pick the lead brand
moves.body: minds + assembly chooses whether VYVGART, EPSOLAY or both go to clients first.

moves.head: Size and list inventory
moves.body: Sabio returns final audience sizes and the publisher list for that brand.

moves.head: Lock the test
moves.body: Start date, budget split and the Rx lift partner agreed with the client.
